title: Unctuous Mexican Shirataki Noodles
description: A tangy, crispy, Jain-friendly, one-pot Mexican dish, inspired by the flavors of Jalisco's cuisine. This recipe combines the crunch of crispy tortilla strips with the earthy sweetness of shirataki noodles.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the ground cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the dashi extract and stir to combine.
Add the cooked shirataki noodles to the skillet and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the noodles are well coated with the spice mixture.
Stir in the lime juice and cook for another minute.
Transfer the noodles to a serving platter.
Sprinkle the crushed tortilla chips and chopped cilantro over the noodles.
Garnish with grated lime zest and serve immediately.
